Maven parent `pom.xml` aggregates `ecommerce-common` and services: `user-service`, `product-service`, `inventory-service`, `cart-service`, `order-service`, `payment-service`, `shipping-service`. Standard layout: `<module>/src/main/java`, `<module>/src/main/resources` (`application.yml`), tests `<module>/src/test/java`; root `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`. Java 21, Maven 3.9+, Docker.
Commands: `mvn clean package`; `mvn -pl user-service -am package`; `mvn -pl user-service spring-boot:run`; `java -jar user-service/target/user-service-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar`; `docker compose up --build`; tests `mvn test` or `mvn -pl order-service test`.
Use 4-space Java formatting, one public class/file; packages `com.example.ecommerce.<service>` with `controller`, `entity`, `repository`, `service`; `lowerCamelCase`, `UPPER_SNAKE_CASE`. Controllers e.g. `UserController` under `/api/...`; entities `User`, `OrderItem`; Spring Data JPA `UserRepository`. Prefer Lombok where used; reuse `ecommerce-common` types (`ApiResponse`). Add JUnit 5/Spring Boot tests (`spring-boot-starter-test`); unit `*Test`, integration `*IT`.
Conventional Commits: `feat:`, `fix:`, `refactor:`, `docs:`; include module scope. PRs: summary, modules, API examples, schema/config notes. Ensure module tests pass before merging. Service config: each module’s `src/main/resources/application.yml`. Do not commit secrets; prefer environment variables. DB defaults: `docker-compose.yml` (`jdbc:mysql://mysql:3306/ecommerce`, user/password `ecommerce`).
